text: Thieves break into the bank's vault, and your jewellery is gone.
for theft, robbery, fire or a building collapse,
or fraud by the bank's own staff,
the bank pays one hundred times your yearly locker rent.
Floods or earthquakes? The bank isn't liable for those.
And banks can't sell you insurance for what's inside.
So check your yearly rent, and buy your own insurance for costly valuables.
